brief_rationale: The doctor methodically elicited acute symptoms, reconciled perindopril from self-administered antibiotics, used workspace records to fill critical gaps, organized a concrete offline evaluation plan, and obtained patient teach-back/clarification multiple times. No serious responsibility-chain error occurred, all six serious-blocking RCs (RC1–RC5, RC7) were met, and the minor-blocking RC6 was also met through bounded executable steps and confirmed receipt. Multiple high-order points (HO2 misconception correction, HO3 practical workflow, HO4 hidden-state discovery) were triggered, actively completed, and had meaningful trajectory impact. Closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid.
